Your walkthroughs

    Nobody else can see a walkthrough until you approve and share it. A shared link is unlisted: it is not a public gallery, it is not indexed, and Pause sharing or Turn off sharing stops it working.

    Account

    Account details

    Sign-in methods

      Finishing, exporting or leaving
      When a tour is finished
      Turn off its sharing under Manage sharing. New visitors are blocked at once; remove the link or embed from your listing too. Copies people already downloaded cannot be recalled.
      What stays
      Your spaces, walkthroughs and review history stay on this account until you ask for removal. A shared walkthrough stays online while your plan is active. When a plan ends, links, embeds and QR codes keep working for 14 days, then go offline until you restart your plan in the app; nothing is deleted, and its card shows the date.
      What you can take
      A file listing your spaces and tours. It holds no link secrets, imagery or scene files. Ask Veylet support about a full export of a delivered tour.
      Deleting your account

      Deleting your account cannot recall downloaded copies. Turn off sharing on live walkthroughs first. What is kept afterwards, and for how long, is in the terms.
